records.title: Server Federation and Request Proxying
records.description:
The server shall support an opt-in federation mode that proxies incoming requests to a configured remote MCP server instance. Routing shall support a global default target and per-workspace overrides. The feature shall include anti-loop protection (via `X-Mcp-Federation-Hop` header with a configurable maximum hop count), transparent SSE/streaming forwarding for `/mcp-transport`, a runtime management REST API at `/mcpserver/federation`, and auto-discovery of federation targets from running tunnel providers.

**Status:** ✅ Complete

**Technical Implementation:** `FederationOptions`, `FederationRegistry`, `FederationProxyService`, `FederationMiddleware`, `FederationController`

**Configuration:** `Mcp:Federation:Enabled`, `Mcp:Federation:Targets`, `Mcp:Federation:DefaultTarget`, `Mcp:Federation:WorkspaceRoutes`, `Mcp:Federation:MaxHops`

records.title: Keyserver signs QuadBrain transactions only

records.description:

- ac-4: Live TurnTransactions.Enabled remains true for QuadBrain; the repo default may stay false.
- ac-5: Focused TransactionGated* tests plus TurnTransactionCoordinatorTests, TurnTransactionKeyserverScopeTests, and BrainSlotInvocationTransactionTests complete with zero failures and zero skips.

records.title: Session turns record current plan file and MCP TODO id
records.notes: PLAN-SESSIONLIFE-001 revision 4 narrows only ordinary first persistence: canceled/cancelled supersession may omit metadata and stores None. All other FR-MCP-SESSIONLOGCTX-001 obligations remain pending.
records.description: Every session-log turn SHALL store planFile and todoId. After persist, query/get SHALL return both fields. They are never null in API output. When no plan or TODO is active, the stored value SHALL be the exact sentinel None (case-sensitive). The first persist of a turn SHALL reject omitted, null, empty, or whitespace planFile or todoId. planFile SHALL accept a workspace-relative path, an exact absolute path, or a ~/ home-relative path. .. is rejected. Query SHALL support exact filters on planFile and todoId, and text search SHALL match those fields. Existing rows SHALL be backfilled from turn contents and agent history under ~. Import, transcript ingest, and federation apply SHALL persist a validated pair (None if extraction finds nothing). Children: AC-FR-MCP-SESSIONLOGCTX-001-001, AC-FR-MCP-SESSIONLOGCTX-001-002, AC-FR-MCP-SESSIONLOGCTX-001-003, AC-FR-MCP-SESSIONLOGCTX-001-004, AC-FR-MCP-SESSIONLOGCTX-001-005, AC-FR-MCP-SESSIONLOGCTX-001-006, AC-FR-MCP-SESSIONLOGCTX-001-007.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every session-log turn SHALL store planFile and todoId. After persist, query/get SHALL return both fields. They are never null in API output.
When no plan or TODO is active, the stored value SHALL be the exact sentinel None (case-sensitive).

The first ordinary persist of a turn SHALL reject omitted, null, empty, or whitespace planFile or todoId and insert no turn row. A canceled or cancelled supersession may omit the pair, stores the exact sentinel None for each missing value, and a durable reopen preserves that bounded exception.
planFile SHALL accept a workspace-relative path, an exact absolute path, or a ~/ home-relative path. .. is rejected.
Query SHALL support exact filters on planFile and todoId, and text search SHALL match those fields.

records.title: Forward-slash storage keys, rekey maintenance command and startup guard
records.notes: P1.5 operator decisions 2026-10-16: Policy A uses existing Windows lexical normalizer including device-prefix stripping and case preservation. Distinct old keys converging abort before mutation. Manual triage keys are SHA-256(workspacePath|manual|random GUID); retain their GroupKey/GroupId because GUID is not stored. Only recompute derived identities verified from persisted inputs. Worktree-only implementation and disposable fixture/copy tests; no live apply, service operations, deploy, or merge. Current task explicitly requests requirements/tests first (red), then implementation.
records.description: WorkspaceIdentityPath.NormalizeLexicalPath emits '/' for Windows paths (UNC keeps leading '//'; \\?\ device prefixes stripped to drive or // form); BuildStorageKey becomes windows:C:/USERS/KINGD style. IsRemoteWindowsPath, IsNormalizedPathWithinRoot and NormalizeLocalAdministrativeShareAlias accept both separators. A ToNativePath helper produces backslash paths only for Win32 CreateFile/GetFinalPathNameByHandle, \\?\ long-path prefixes and cmd.exe arguments. Persisted data is rewritten by an explicit maintenance command --workspace-path-rekey (decision D5, 2026-10-07) modelled on McpDatabaseEncryptionTransitionCommand: required backup unless --dry-run, report with old->new mapping and before/after counts; one transaction per database with foreign keys deferred or suspended and fully re-validated (decision D6: SQLite defer_foreign_keys, SQL Server NOCHECK then WITH CHECK CHECK, PostgreSQL DEFERRABLE + SET CONSTRAINTS ALL DEFERRED); set-based UPDATE per workspace column from a mapping table limited to Windows-shaped values; C# recomputation of hashed values (federation GlobalWorkspaceId/CanonicalWorkspaceId and hub hash-keyed Workspaces rows, TriageGroups GroupKey/GroupId with repointed children, HandoffIngestionRuns ReplayIdentity); FileGitHubWorkspaceTokenStore keys rewritten. No legacy dual-key lookup (decision D7): a startup guard refuses to start while any Windows-shaped workspace id still contains a backslash. Enrolled proxies are re-enrolled once after deploy (only PAYTON-LEGION2 today). Plan: docs/plans/2026-10-07-federation-fixes.md section 4c.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reuse P1.4 Windows lexical normalization, preserve case, and reject distinct old keys converging before any database mutation.
Apply requires successful verified backup; all database changes and FK validation occur in one transaction; repeat apply is a no-op.
Dry-run inventory and planning run only on a database copy; report mappings, table and workspace counts, and retained manual triage hashes without secrets.
HTTP and STDIO startup refuse legacy Windows workspace ids and point to --workspace-path-rekey.
Recompute only derivable triage, handoff, and federation identities; repoint children; preserve manual triage hashes and rewrite token-store keys with file backup.

records.title: Bounded outbound session-log sanitizer
records.description: A single sanitizer decorator must clone session-log DTO graphs, apply validated default and configured regex rules with deterministic replacement tokens and finite timeouts, and wrap the final local or federated ISessionLogService read result.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ISessionLogSanitizer exposes DTO and string sanitization without mutating caller-owned objects.
SessionLogSanitizationOptions limits rule count, pattern length, and per-match timeout; invalid or duplicate rule IDs fail options validation with the offending ID.
Default rules cover bearer tokens, JWTs, private keys, common API-key and secret assignments, connection-string passwords, and known provider token prefixes.
Replacement is deterministic as [REDACTED:<rule-id>] and does not expose captured secret fragments.
SessionLogSanitizingService is the outermost ISessionLogService read decorator for HTTP/federation and is also registered in stdio.
Regex timeout during a read fails closed for the affected value, emits rule diagnostics without the input value, and never returns the unsanitized value.

records.title: Sanitizer timeout fail-open is deterministically testable
records.description: The session-log sanitizer per-rule regex evaluation SHALL be exposed through an injectable seam (RegexReplaceInvoker, defaulting to Regex.Replace in production) so its timeout fail-open behavior can be verified deterministically - forcing exactly one field/rule to raise RegexMatchTimeoutException - independent of catastrophic-backtracking wall-clock jitter. Acceptance Criteria: (AC1) with an injected invoker that raises RegexMatchTimeoutException for the pathological field, SanitizeString returns [REDACTED:{ruleId}:timeout] for that field while other fields continue to be sanitized by their rules, across repeated isolated runs (no flake); (AC2) production behavior is unchanged (default invoker is Regex.Replace). Origin: BUG-TRIAGE-081 (SessionLogSanitizerTimeoutTests flaked under scheduler jitter; the deployed 1ms->100ms budget was a mitigation, not deterministic). Validated by TEST-MCP-SESSIONLOGSAN-002.

records.description: Validates TR-MCP-SESSIONLOGSAN-002. tests/McpServer.Support.Mcp.Tests/Services/SessionLogSanitizerTimeoutTests.cs: CreateTimeoutSanitizer now constructs SessionLogSanitizer with an injected RegexReplaceInvoker that raises RegexMatchTimeoutException deterministically for the catastrophic rule on large input (length>10000 + pattern match, no wall-clock). SanitizeString_WhenConfiguredRuleTimesOut_ReturnsTimeoutTokenAndDoesNotLogInput and SanitizeSessionLog_WhenOneFieldTimesOut_ContinuesSanitizingOtherFields verified 10/10 green across repeated isolated runs (previously flaked pass/pass/fail). Production path uses the default Regex.Replace invoker.
